cohort: The study participants were 1843 women universally screened for gestational diabetes (GDM) who received routine ultrasounds each trimester.
finding: The study found no significant differences in fetal size throughout pregnancy or in the incidence of large-for-gestational age (LGA) neonates between women with gestational diabetes (GDM) and those with normal glucose tolerance (NGT), and estimated fetal weight (EFW) centile at 28-33 weeks correlated well with birthweight.
birth_weight: Birthweight was categorized by centile (LGA, SGA, AGA).
gest_age: Gestational age was used to categorize neonates as large, small, or appropriate for gestational age, and fetal assessments were made between 24-33 weeks.
